newTerms.personal-spirit / personal-power suprema: supremacía de espíritu personal / supremacía de poder personal

forcedChoices.reason: Here 'translation' is the passage of a concept into mortal terms, not the glossary sense of mortal translation (traslación).

forcedChoices.choice: la Primera Fuente y Centro es infinitamente más compleja
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish needs a gender; the feminine follows the head noun 'Fuente', as in the fixed form.

forcedChoices.choice: como Padre espiritual de ustedes; el Padre de ustedes y mi Padre
forcedChoices.reason: Avoids 'su', which can also read 'his'; the text speaks to the reader in the plural.
'actually' can mean 'in fact' or 'in act'; 'realmente' keeps both readings open better than 'en acto'.

forcedChoices.choice: en cuanto su unidad se concibe
forcedChoices.reason: 'as' can be temporal or 'insofar as'; 'en cuanto' keeps both readings.
'los últimos' as a plural noun reads as 'the last ones'; the glossary short form 'Ultimidad' carries the absonite sense.
Gender forced; masculine because Havona is a universe (el universo central).
'orden' as a class of beings is masculine in Spanish.
Feminine agrees with 'personalidades' and 'la mente', the subjects of each sentence.
